Hi Sarah — great to hear you're ready. Quick responses below and a couple of asks so we can finalize on our side.

1) Invoice routing:
- Primary: invoices@redwood.com (preferred for automated ingestion)
- Secondary (PO exceptions): finance-inbound@redwood.com
- We require the PO number in the invoice header (PO: ######) and a separate CSV-friendly line for Project Code where applicable.

2) Payment terms:
- Redwood default for new vendors is Net 45 (international and US) while we complete vendor verification and tax checks.
- Net 30 can be approved for US-headquartered vendors with completed onboarding score >= 85 and a verified W-9.
- Net 60 is rare; only approved by Finance for long-term strategic partnerships.

3) PO field mapping:
- I've attached our PO_Field_Mapping_Template.csv. If you can map your fields to our template and return it, Procurement will ingest it into our PO gateway.

4) Early-pay program:
- We offer an early-pay option (15-day remittance) for a small discount; program is called "QuickSettle." Enrollment requires a signed Addendum and acceptance of the earlypay_terms.pdf. Fee: typically 1.75% off invoice for 15-day settlement (variable by risk profile).

Action items for Orchid Systems:
- Fill and return Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.xlsx (attached)
- Map PO fields using PO_Field_Mapping_Template.csv and return
- Provide completed W-9 (if US) or equivalent tax form

I'll loop in Grace from Finance to confirm the exception path for Net 30 and who signs the QuickSettle addendum. If you want a short call to run through the template, propose a couple times and we'll book.

Thanks — Kar

Hi Sarah — thanks for starting this. From Finance perspective here's the guardrails and the fast path if Orchid wants Net 30 or QuickSettle.

- Default term: Net 45 while vendor verification runs (tax docs, bank verification, AML checks). This reduces manual exceptions and protects month-end close.
- Net 30 eligibility: available to US vendors only, requires
  * completed onboarding form
  * verified W-9 on file
  * automated bank micro-deposit complete
  * credit score (internal) >= 85
  Approval authority: VP Finance (Logan Wright) — I'll prepare a fast-track approver packet to reduce turnaround.

- QuickSettle (early pay):
  * Typical structure: 15-day payout at invoice less 1.75% discount.
  * Enrollment: signed Addendum + vendor bank verification + acceptance of terms in earlypay_terms.pdf
  * For strategic vendors we can negotiate fee down to ~1.25% with a 6-month volume commitment.

- PO routing: invoices@redwood.com is the canonical ingestion address. For paper invoices or special AP contacts, cc finance-inbound@redwood.com. Ensure the PO number is machine-readable (single-line header).

I can expedite Net 30 approvals if Orchid returns the onboarding form and bank verification by EOD Thursday; Logan has tentatively pre-approved the policy for partners on our onboarding playbook.

Grace O'Connor
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
